latest.score_definition: Heuristic geometric support in [0,1], not a calibrated probability or safety confidence
latest.reason: Vertical/mixed returns interrupt the footprint; stairs not established
assumptions: Metres; x forward, y left, z up; already gravity aligned
Calibrated sensor-to-body transform and synchronized pose supplied by caller
Straight stair flight approximately aligned with forward direction
limits: Prototype geometry only; no collision clearance, load capacity or traversability guarantee
Required lanes must cover the full forward ROI; sparse or occluded scans can miss real stairs
No rear-foot or landing-clearance proof; flat means the visible forward footprint only
No freshness check here; caller must reject stale data and invalid transforms
The existing 1100 policy has not been validated for real stairs or descending stairs

assumptions: odom z is gravity-aligned; this is an assumption pending calibration
local x/y follow base yaw; local z is relative to the base origin
cloud and odometry source stamps share a clock; host synchronization is checked separately
geometry preview is not a controller readiness or traversability assessment
recognition_scope: single-frame geometric candidates only; no multi-frame confirmation
transport_note: Only sensor subscriptions; DDS discovery and ROS framework parameter events may transmit. No application publishers or services.

source_time.clock_note: Timestamp proximity alone does not establish clock synchronization; a mismatch may be clock offset or delayed data. No offset correction applied.

capture.note: Last analyzed finite frame; may be older than final report. No control readiness implied.
